## Orca worktree rules

Applies to agents in an Orca task worktree (`cc-*` Claude, `cx-*` Codex). The
master session follows the `orca-dev-ops` skill instead.

- The master session plans, reviews, commits, rebases, merges, and pushes.
  Implement the plan it sent without re-planning, and ask through
  `orca orchestration ask` when the plan is unclear.
- Leave all changes uncommitted. Never run `git commit`, `push`, `merge`, or
  `rebase`, never touch `master`, and never create or remove worktrees.
- Report through `orca orchestration send` (or `worker_done` when dispatched)
  in four lines: result / changed files / test results / open issues.
- Run the verification this repository requires before reporting done.
- Do not edit a file another active task worktree has declared in its scope.
<!-- orca-worktree-rules:end -->
